scope.summary: Build the channel slider panels per Section 13.27 GUI clauses: sliders grouped by region (breasts, shoulders, hips, glutes, thighs, midriff, hands/feet, genitals, face) with numeric entry, designed over-range indication (past 100% is shown, not blocked), and the isolate-region toggle surfacing the MT-495/496 decouple machinery (OBR-001..004 as the panel's information architecture).
acceptance_criteria: Sliders render grouped by region exactly matching the channel registry's region taxonomy; every slider has a stable author_id derived from its channel id.

Each slider offers direct numeric entry; measurement-backed channels display cm; values past 100% into the designed over-range render with a distinct over-range indication and remain fully draggable (extreme builds are the product target, never soft-blocked).
The isolate-region toggle per group disables incoming coupling links (MT-496) for that region and visibly marks the isolated state.
Slider edits round-trip through the edit_body CRDT lane (no direct state mutation); concurrent model edits to other channels appear live without clobbering the operator's drag.
Argus can read and set any slider by author_id headlessly; a capture confirms viewport response to a slider change.
scope.risk_if_missed: The core authoring surface either hides the over-range extremes the operator builds on, or bypasses the CRDT lane and desyncs GUI state from model edits during parallel sessions.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
